question:
For each positive integer $n$, define a function $f_n$ on $[0,1]$ as follows:
\[
f_n(x)=\begin{cases}
0,&x=0,\\
\sin\frac{\pi}{2n},&0<x\le\frac1n,\\
\sin\frac{2\pi}{2n},&\frac1n<x\le\frac2n,\\
\sin\frac{3\pi}{2n},&\frac2n<x\le\frac3n,\\
\vdots&\vdots\\
\sin\frac{n\pi}{2n},&\frac{n-1}{n}<x\le1.
\end{cases}
\]
